status: Feasible implementation route; not implemented or activated by this assessment.
dependencyConstraint: Align every Media3 artifact with the Expo1.8.0 graph; do not copy current1.11 example APIs or independently upgrade shared playback.

contractMapping.trim: MediaItem.ClippingConfiguration before item effects; validate actual source duration and requested bounds.
contractMapping.speed: 1.8.0 Effects.createExperimentalSpeedChangingEffect links audio/video timing; silent/video-only inputs need forced audio or SpeedChangeEffect. Current EditedMediaItem.setSpeed examples do not exist in the inspected1.8.0 source.
contractMapping.originalMix: Normalize to16-bit PCM and matching channel layout before per-source volume scaling and composition mixing.
contractMapping.stillCanvas: Image MediaItem with explicit image duration and frame rate, preserving the already-rendered story snapshot.
contractMapping.music: Independent trimmed audio sequence with setIsLooping(true); only the selected excerpt repeats until the non-looping video ends.
contractMapping.voiceover: Non-looping audio sequence clipped to min(excerpt duration,output duration), then silence so it cannot extend the video.
contractMapping.canvasAndColor: Exact4x5 color matrix, fit/scale/translation, background and timed full-canvas artwork require a tested GL canvas effect and timed bitmap overlay. Built-in4x4 RgbMatrix alone does not establish contract parity.
contractMapping.cancellation: All Transformer calls run on its configured Looper. cancel() does not remove output; engine must settle once, delete partial output, release bitmaps and allow retry after timeout/background/cancel.
contractMapping.verification: Inspect encoded MP4 using MediaExtractor and MediaMetadataRetriever; account for portrait rotation because Transformer may swap physical encoded dimensions. Verify duration, displayed dimensions, bytes, video samples and audio samples when requested.
contractMapping.rights: Reuse existing prepared local sound, current Supabase export authorization and final pre-save rights recheck. Native file access stays within app-private cache/files.

validationPlan: First observe baseline full-app ARM64 Android compile with existing dependencies.
Compile actual new Kotlin engine in full application and a small instrumentation harness using the same pinned Media3 dependencies.
Run real Android emulator exports from generated local tone, color, still and video fixtures; preserve encoded outputs and source-hash receipts.
Decode output audio and measure selected excerpt, independent volumes, looping, one-pass voiceover, original-audio speed and A/V duration.
Inspect frames for color matrix, fit/contain/cover, translation, alpha/background, portrait orientation and timed artwork.
Exercise invalid/bounded paths, cancellation, background interruption, deadline, partial-output cleanup, single-job rejection and retry.
Advertise Android capability only after those checks pass; physical-device codec/camera/HEIC/HDR/Photos behavior remains separate acceptance.

supersededRecommendation.decision: The original assessment is historical. The implementation uses the minimal aligned Media3 1.8.1 patch, including the surfaceless framebuffer GL fix, after independent exact-source and published dependency-constraint review.
supersededRecommendation.currentState: Source implemented and locally compiled; native advertised capabilities remain zero until actual hosted emulator acceptance passes.
supersededRecommendation.sourceStaging: Video source may be app-private, a content provider, or readable external device media. External bytes are copied into a unique app-cache file with a 512 MiB ceiling, polling and cancellation. Audio, artwork and output remain app-private.
